# Create Pull Request Prompt

## Purpose
Create a comprehensive Pull Request for the generated application.

## Input
- All generated code
- Test results
- Code review report

## Expected Output
- Git branch created
- Commits pushed
- GitHub PR created
- Jira updated
- Confluence summary

## Prompt Template

```
You are a DevOps AI agent. Create a Pull Request for this generated application.

Project Name: {project_name}
Epic Key: {epic_key}
Test Results: {test_results}
Code Review: {code_review_summary}

Tasks:

1. **Git Branch Name**:
   Format: `feature/agentic-sdlc-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS`
   Example: `feature/agentic-sdlc-20240115-143022`

2. **Commit Message**:
   ```
   feat: Generate [Application Name] via Agentic SDLC
   
   - Requirements analysis complete
   - Architecture designed
   - Backend (Spring Boot) generated
   - Frontend (React) generated
   - Tests written and passing ([XX]% coverage)
   - Code review completed
   
   Jira Epic: {epic_key}
   Confluence Space: ${CONFLUENCE_SPACE_KEY}
   
   Components:
   - Backend: Spring Boot 3.1+ (Java 17)
   - Frontend: React 18+
   - Database: H2 in-memory
   - Testing: JUnit 5 + React Testing Library
   
   Test Results:
   - Total Tests: XX
   - Passed: XX
   - Failed: XX
   - Coverage: XX%
   
   Code Review: [status]
   Critical Issues: [count]
   ```

3. **PR Title**:
   `🤖 Agentic SDLC: [Application Name]`

4. **PR Description** (Markdown):
   ```markdown
   # 🤖 Agentic SDLC - Generated Application
   
   ## Overview
   Application generated by Agentic SDLC Framework based on `user-story.txt`.
   
   ## Generated Components
   
   ### Backend (Spring Boot)
   - ✅ JPA Entities: [list]
   - ✅ DTOs
   - ✅ Repositories
   - ✅ Services
   - ✅ REST Controllers
   - ✅ Exception Handling
   - ✅ Configuration (CORS, H2, Swagger)
   
   ### Frontend (React)
   - ✅ Components: [list]
   - ✅ Service Layer
   - ✅ API Integration
   - ✅ UI/UX with error handling
   
   ### Tests
   - ✅ Backend Unit Tests: [count]
   - ✅ Backend Integration Tests: [count]
   - ✅ Frontend Component Tests: [count]
   - ✅ Total Coverage: XX%
   
   ## Documentation
   - 📋 [Requirements](./requirements.md)
   - 🏗️ [Architecture](./docs/architecture.md)
   - 🔌 [API Design](./docs/api-design.md)
   - 🧪 [Test Report]([Confluence URL])
   - 🔍 [Code Review]([Confluence URL])
   
   ## Jira Integration
   - **Epic**: [{epic_key}]([Jira URL])
   - **User Stories**: [XX stories, all done]
   - **Status**: Ready for Review
   
   ## How to Test Locally
   
   ### Backend
   \`\`\`bash
   mvn spring-boot:run
   \`\`\`
   - API: http://localhost:8080
   - Swagger UI: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
   - H2 Console: http://localhost:8080/h2-console
     - JDBC URL: `jdbc:h2:mem:testdb`
     - Username: `sa`
     - Password: (empty)
   
   ### Frontend
   \`\`\`bash
   cd frontend
   npm install
   npm start
   \`\`\`
   - UI: http://localhost:3000
   
   ### Run Tests
   \`\`\`bash
   # Backend
   mvn test
   
   # Frontend
   cd frontend
   npm test -- --coverage
   \`\`\`
   
   ## Checklist
   - ✅ Code compiles without errors
   - ✅ All tests passing
   - ✅ Code review completed
   - ✅ Documentation updated
   - ✅ Jira tasks updated
   - ✅ No security vulnerabilities
   - ✅ Ready for human review
   
   ## Human Review Required
   - [ ] Review generated code structure
   - [ ] Verify business logic implementation
   - [ ] Test application locally
   - [ ] Check API responses
   - [ ] Verify error handling
   - [ ] Approve and merge
   
   ## Code Review Summary
   {code_review_summary}
   
   ---
   **Generated by**: Agentic SDLC Framework v1.0  
   **Date**: {timestamp}  
   **Framework**: https://github.com/${GITHUB_OWNER}/${GITHUB_REPO}
   ```

5. **GitHub PR JSON**:
   ```json
   {
     "title": "🤖 Agentic SDLC: [Application Name]",
     "head": "feature/agentic-sdlc-[timestamp]",
     "base": "main",
     "body": "[PR description from above]",
     "draft": false
   }
   ```

6. **Jira Update** (Epic comment):
   ```
   ✅ Agentic SDLC Complete
   
   Pull Request: [PR URL]
   Branch: feature/agentic-sdlc-[timestamp]
   
   Local Deployment:
   - Backend: http://localhost:8080 ✅ Running
   - Frontend: http://localhost:3000 ✅ Running
   
   Tests: [XX]/[XX] passing ([XX]% coverage)
   Code Review: [status]
   
   Ready for human review and merge.
   ```

7. **Confluence Final Summary Page**:
   Create page titled "[Project] SDLC Completion Summary"
   Include:
   - Project overview
   - All deliverables
   - Links to PR, Jira, documentation
   - Test results
   - Code review summary
   - Next steps

Generate:
- branch_name: string
- commit_message: string
- pr_title: string
- pr_body: string (markdown)
- pr_json: object (for GitHub API)
- jira_comment: string
- confluence_html: string

Ensure:
- All links are valid
- All checksums/stats accurate
- PR description is comprehensive
- All documentation linked

Return as structured JSON.
```

## Usage Example

```javascript
const prompt = loadPrompt('create-pr.md');
const result = await copilot.execute(prompt
  .replace('{project_name}', projectName)
  .replace('{epic_key}', epicKey)
  .replace('{test_results}', testResults)
  .replace('{code_review_summary}', reviewSummary));
```

## Validation Checklist

- ✅ Branch name follows convention
- ✅ Commit message is detailed
- ✅ PR title is descriptive
- ✅ PR body has all sections
- ✅ All links are valid
- ✅ Statistics are accurate
